messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: This medicine may impair your thinking or reactions. Be careful if you drive or do anything that requires you to be alert.
Avoid drinking fruit juices or taking vitamin C at the same time you take Adderall. These can make your body absorb less of the medicine.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "impairs", "thinking"]

The relation 'impairs' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug negatively affects the specified cognitive or physical function specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
D. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
